title: 75kWh Wall-Mounted Battery Storage in Romania with Deye Inverter (June 2026)
summary: Five 15kWh wall-mounted modules, 75kWh in total, with a Deye inverter in Romania.
challenge: Romania's support policies for distributed PV raised interest in self-consumption, and the client wanted substantial capacity for a premium household.
solution: Five 15kWh wall-mounted modules paralleled through the BMS for 75kWh, behind a Deye inverter.
result: Capacity grows by adding modules, and the wall format keeps the bank out of the living space.
